page.layout: One printed page, single text column, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre; page number at top left.

main_text.p:
Facultas ualde imbecilla, & calor igneus:
Parvos, tardos, & creberrimos.

Modice imbecilla, & calor igneus:
Aeque crebros: sed in distensione & motu, moderatos.

Facultas imbecilla, & refrigeratio:
Parvos, tardos, sed non creberrimos.

Prostrata omnino:
Minimos, intermittentes frequenter, & deficientes.

Calor & facultas: increscentes:
Quàm vehementissimos, maximos: sed non celerrimos, neque creberrimos aperte.

Facultatis robur, & caloris defectus:
Moderatos, magnos, tardiores, & bene rarðs: maximè, vbi polleat refrigeratio.

Arteriæ fola mollities, seclusis aliis caufis, parit
Maiores, celeriores, & raros.

Durities cum caloris innati refrigeratione:
Minores iusto, & tardiores.

Duritiés refrigeratione superior:
Minores quàm tardiores, crebriores.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The line "Parvos" in the scan reads "Paruos"; "Tardiores" at the foot is set in italic. Word "rarðs" at the end of the paragraph beginning "Facultatis robur" is a doubtful reading of "rarös:"; the scan shows "ros:" after a hyphenated "ra-", so it should read "rarös:". Lines with italic text are rendered without <i> markup for simplicity.
